scope: Synthetic anonymous HTTP, actual account-scoped IndexedDB/Blobs, Linux Chromium; no operating accounts, private package, deployment or native Apple claim.

suites.name: unified-search
checks: Home opens one private search; blank and no-match states do not list stored contents
Mixed results distinguish originals, saved pages, private notes and bounded collection groups
Exact old version and raw Korean range reopen; returning keeps query, limits and focused result
Saved page opens its exact expanded post without creating an edit draft; contextual return works
Collection exact detail, explicit archived scope and editing failure preserve the search origin
Drafts excluded, composition input does not query midway, query never enters the URL
A failed collection read retains source/page results and retries without losing query
Late reads cannot replace another screen; separate account has no query or results
Switching workspace clears query, filters and all previous results

suites.name: nine-board-search
checks: Stored board root opens the chosen board overview and returning preserves exact result focus
Area description and spaced Korean reason open the exact area and item with the reason visible
All saved items are searchable; kind, expanded limit and focus survive return without persisting the query
A two-tab reorder invalidates the item snapshot and offers reload; changed and removed areas never open replacements
An aborted save sends no change notice; a committed save does, and a board read failure retains page results
Opening saved posts after a board leaves the board; unapplied edits block return and remain on screen
Late board reads cannot reopen a departed screen; another workspace and account cannot see the query or board

suites.name: photo-post
checks: Entering the photo editor cannot hide an unsaved legacy draft after a failed transaction
A blog-style editor inserts unchanged 4032px originals between paragraphs; formatting, captions and undo preserve bytes
Inline captions keep the same focused input through spaces, newlines, composition and history; save remains reachable in a long post
Saving, full-size reading, original download and reload retain dimensions and all text/photo order
One default entry creates text-only posts and a shared dated feed preserves existing attachment posts and original photo previews
Editing a saved post resumes its matching retained edit draft without replacing the saved post or making another draft
ZIP export and explicit restore create a private draft with new ids and exact original hashes
A failed IndexedDB write blocks departure, keeps the same editor/caret and can be retried without changing the saved original
Concurrent saved-post edits preserve the competing original and offer an explicit new saved copy
Invalid photo types, remote image paste and failed imports do not replace text or install hidden photos
A conflicted draft can make a fresh memory copy even when its original CAS fails; copy failure retains the same editor and every original byte
A competing save cannot replace file-review choices; rereading waits for explicit restore or cancellation
Photos stay scoped to the verified account and workspace; original records, drafts and 9-slot boards remain exact

nineBoardCaptureFix.change: Await natural completion of finite document animations before the existing contrast/target/overflow inspection. All assertion thresholds remain unchanged.
